title: The First Miles Beyond a Car Rental Allowance Carried Free
content:
The first miles beyond the included allowance on a rental of the Car Rental Rate Classes may be carried free. Whether they are, and how many, is read from the damage recharges standing on the rental and from the rental day lines standing on its ledger.

**The grace schedule.**

| What stands on the rental | Miles carried free |
|---|---|
| No damage recharge, and rental day lines for 7 days or more | 120 |
| No damage recharge, and rental day lines for fewer than 7 days | 60 |
| A damage recharge | No mile at all |

**The two parts of each condition.** The first two entitlements require the absence of a damage recharge and a count of rental day lines together. Where any damage recharge stands on the rental, no mile beyond the allowance is carried free, however many rental day lines stand beside it.

**Both sides of the threshold, on hypothetical rentals with no damage recharge standing.**

| Rental day lines standing | Miles carried free |
|---|---|
| 12 | 120 |
| 7 | 120 |
| 6 | 60 |
| 1 | 60 |

A rental carrying 7 rental day lines and one damage recharge carries no mile free, and so does a rental carrying 3 rental day lines and one damage recharge.
